title: Data-plane quarantine-aware rolling upgrade orchestrator
creator: Aisha N. Patel
description:
Problem: Private (VPC) data-plane runtime upgrades are high-risk for tenant-facing latency spikes or cold-start errors due to KV cache loss, priming variance, and asymmetric traffic shaping. Current rolling upgrade controller lacks an explicit quarantine phase to isolate unprimed replicas before full traffic takeover.

Goal: Implement a quarantine-aware rolling upgrade orchestrator integrated with Terraform/IaC and runtime control plane that enables: (1) deterministic zero-downtime upgrades for VPC/private deployments, (2) automated priming and health quorum checks, (3) safe and fast rollbacks when SLOs or priming expectations fail, and (4) Terraform-friendly hooks so customers can opt into conservative or aggressive profiles via module flags.
acceptance_criteria: New orchestrator introduced and deployed in our private control plane feature branch
Quarantine phase prevents >5% traffic to unprimed replicas until priming health-quorum is reached
Automated rollback triggers on multi-metric safety gate (latency P99, error rate, priming-miss ratio) within configured windows
Smoke tests and chaos test harnesses validate upgrade and rollback flows in staging with synthetic tenants
Migration path documented for existing customers and ops runbook published in Confluence
design_notes: Introduce 'quarantine' lifecycle: PROVISION -> QUARANTINE (no production traffic or <= X% shadowing) -> PRIMED -> PROMOTE (traffic shift) -> STABLE
Quarantine behavior implemented in runtime agent: new replicas register with control plane as 'quarantine' and only accept shadow/canary traffic and health probes until primed
Priming definition: KV cache hit-rate >= 85% over a rolling 60s window AND synthetic sequence latency below threshold AND application-level 'warm' probe success count >= N
Health quorum: require >70% of replicas in slice to be PRIMED before progressing promotion for that slice/tenant

Terraform: add redwood_private_runtime_group resource with 'quarantine_policy' block (min_quarantine_replicas, max_shadow_percent, priming_probe_config) and lifecycle hooks for pre/post upgrade scripts
Fallbacks: on insufficient priming within timeout, controller performs staged rollback to previous runtime image and triggers incident automation with telemetry snapshot
rollout_plan: 1. Feature branch: implement controller and runtime quarantine registration in private control plane (dev cluster)
2. Terraform module patch: add quarantine_policy for customers to enable/disable and choose profile
3. Staging rollout: enable quarantine for a subset of staging tenants; run priming telemetry and refine thresholds
4. Canary in prod (low-risk tenants): enable for 10 tenants, run for 72h, validate KPIs
5. Gradual ramp: increase tenant percentage, monitor dashboards and automated SLO gates
6. Full rollout: flip default upgrade_profile to 'balanced' for new deployments; existing customers can opt-in
7. Post-rollout: 30-day observation window and retrospective; add operator-focused telemetry to Console
rollback_playbook: Automatic triggers: sustained P99 latency increase >20% for 5 minutes, error rate spike >2x baseline, priming-miss ratio >0.25 over 10 minutes
Immediate action: controller halts promotion and drains traffic from newly promoted replicas back to previous version via routing policy rollback
KV reconciliation: if rollback causes partial state divergence, trigger per-tenant KV replay from pre-upgrade snapshot (snapshot retention and replay orchestrated via IaC hooks)
Operator steps: run `redwoodctl rollback --group <id> --reason <alert-id>` to enact manual rollback; follow incident runbook to collect traces and heap/kv diagnostics
Post-rollback verification: ensure priming hit-rate and latency return to baseline for >3 consecutive windows before reattempting upgrade
Communication: auto-notify affected customers via status page and include exact time windows, rollback reason, and next steps
telemetry_and_checks: New metrics: quarantine_replica_count, priming_hit_rate, priming_probe_success_count, shadow_request_ratio, promotion_window_duration
SLO gates: latency P95/P99 thresholds, error_rate per-tenancy, priming_hit_rate baseline
Synthetic probes: route synthetic sequences that exercise KV-heavy paths and long-context generation; probe results feed into priming metric
Traces: attach distributed traces for requests hitting 'promoted' vs 'quarantine' replicas to compare cost/latency
Dashboards: per-tenant priming dashboard and a rollouts view showing per-slice promotion state and time-to-primed
terraform_changes: Add resource: redwood_vpc_runtime_group with fields: machine_type, image_tag, quarantine_policy, scale_settings
New variable: upgrade_profile (conservative|balanced|aggressive) exposed in modules/redwood_private
Lifecycle hooks: pre_upgrade_command (e.g., run prewarm job), post_upgrade_check_url, rollback_snapshot_policy
State migration: provide migration script to convert existing runtime groups to include quarantine_policy with conservative defaults
Module docs: examples showing toggling quarantine_enabled and recommended profiles for regulated customers
testing_and_chaos_plan: Unit tests: controller state machine transitions (PROVISION->QUARANTINE->PRIMED->PROMOTE)
Integration tests: staging clusters simulate heavy KV load and validate priming_hit_rate gating
Chaos tests: node CPU/IO disruption during quarantine and promotion phases to validate safe rollback
Load tests: ramp traffic while promoting replicas to ensure the shadowing limits hold and latency remains within SLOs
Customer simulation: create synthetic tenants with large KV working sets to emulate worst-case priming time
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: false-positive priming failure due to noisy probes. Mitigation: use composite probe (multiple probes & rolling windows) and adaptive thresholds
Risk: increased deployment time for conservative profile. Mitigation: offer balanced/aggressive profiles and clear defaults; provide cost/latency tradeoff table
Risk: Terraform state drift when adding quarantine_policy. Mitigation: provide migration tool and clear apply plan messages; include automated acceptance checks in CI
Risk: KV replay cost and storage. Mitigation: limit replay window, compress snapshots, and chargeable optional feature for long-tail replay storage
